caps_source: Ventus Config.scala defaults (SIMT32, 32 warps, 64KB shared memory).
verify: DCache flush control path (flushChoosen) in DCache.scala
MemReqArb valid/ready handshake to the memory interface

#1.note: Same-cycle issue and writeback to the same register clear the new writer's busy bit.

#2.note: Shared-memory lanes are routed through DCache when shared accesses coexist, violating per-lane routing.

#3.note: A cache flush clears the dirty bit before writeback acceptance; backpressure discards the request.

#4.note: Missing saturating arithmetic entries in the vector decode table: the instruction executes without writing its result.

notes: Parameters are starting points taken from each project's documented defaults. They are data: adjust caps to the configuration you elaborate, then run `python3 cli.py doctor --target ventus`.
